name: SaveWriteInventoryArray
signature: void SaveWriteInventoryArray(void* stream, void* unk, u8* src, u8 flag)
description: writes save field 0x938A61DD (amrita 'inventory'): hash, size 600000, then 600000 bytes (2500 items x 240 B) via SaveStreamWriteU32 + per-byte writer 0x6bbed4
source: notes/amrita-tools.md §3 Save format in the exe

name: SaveStreamWriteU32
description: appends a u32 to the user-save tagged stream; used for every field hash/size of the {u32 hash,u32 size,data} record format (297 callers)
source: notes/amrita-tools.md §3 Save format in the exe

name: SaveWriteSoulCoreHistory
signature: void* SaveWriteSoulCoreHistory(void* stream, void** out, u32 n, u8* src)
description: writes save field 0x1798DF25 (soul-core Transformation history): hash, count 2000, 8000-byte array; called from SaveUserWritePlayerSection
source: notes/amrita-tools.md §3 Save format in the exe

name: SaveWriteEquippedGearBlock
signature: void* SaveWriteEquippedGearBlock(void* stream, void** out, u32 n, u8* src)
description: writes save field 0x6B52DB66 (amrita 'equippedGear'): hash, count 2, 0x88-byte span
source: notes/amrita-tools.md §3 Save format in the exe

name: SaveUserReadInventorySection
description: user-save load path for the inventory section (compares field hash 0x938A61DD); pairs with SaveUserWriteInventorySection

name: SaveUserReadPlayerSection
description: 14.5 KB user-save field reader: mov edx,<fieldHash>; r8=[r14]+off; call typed reader, for stats 0x607E11FF(+0x94), baseStats 0x614D187E(+0xB0), learnedSkills, guardians, soul-core history etc. Same 4 callers as SaveUserWritePlayerSection (0x106d7a0 0x106e9d0 0x106dd30 0x1072340)
source: notes/amrita-tools.md §3 Save format in the exe

name: SaveUserReadEquipSection
description: user-save load path for equipped gear / soul cores / shortcuts (field hashes 0x54B78304 0x6B52DB66 0xAB0E9943 0x36BFE4B6 0xF3EF06E4)
source: notes/amrita-tools.md §3 Save format in the exe

name: SaveUserReadScrollSection
description: user-save load path for the Picture Scroll array (field hash 0xD73A7C7F, 232-byte records)
source: notes/amrita-tools.md §3 Save format in the exe

name: SaveUserReadPresetSection
description: user-save load path for equipment presets (field hash 0x7D6AB068; 19 presets x 32976 B)
source: notes/amrita-tools.md §3 Save format in the exe

name: SaveUserWriteInventorySection

name: SaveUserWritePlayerSection

name: SaveUserWriteEquipSection

name: SaveUserWriteScrollSection

name: SaveUserWritePresetSection
description: user-save write path for equipment presets (field hash 0x7D6AB068)
